items.source_en:
Why is it that Genghis dies and comes back so very very fast? He's died x3 or x5 more than anyone? And you wait a year, and he's back.

He looks at everything as a prisoner trying to break out. Very consistent. But each rebirth, he can be very different. Sometimes friendlier, sometimes moodier, sometimes too much of a socialite. But always with an angle.

If he is anything like the historical, I could see why he did so well. Far smarter than he appears, and willing to do almost anything to achieve his goals.

items.source_en:
What is Ensign Palavi doing that requires him to type ALL day? 

The worst part is he has one of those annoying, one finger typing techniques that is the equivalent of paint drying in zero gravity. 

Is he writing a novel? Because no single military report requires that much typing. He's made it so I can't even think, because all I do is rage.

Well, two can play at that game. I'm just going to type loudly and self-importantly until he can no longer keep the chapters in his story straight.

No great fiction will be written by your hand tonight, Ensign Palavi. Not if I can help it.
items.legacy_ko:
도대체 팔라비 소위는 하루 종일 무엇을 타이핑하고 있는 거지? 

가장 최악인 게 그 인간은 한 손가락으로만 키보드를 치는 독수리 타법을 쓰고 있단 거다. 무중력 상태에서 그림을 그리고 난 뒤 페인트가 마를 때까지 멍하니 기다리는 것과 똑같을 정도로 아주 느린 기술이지.

소설이라도 쓰고 있는 건가? 군사 보고서에 그토록 타이핑이 많이 필요한 것은 없을 텐데. 저 녀석 때문에 화가 치밀어 올라서 아무 생각도 못하겠어.

나도 이 게임에 동참해 주지. 아주 시끄럽게, 거들먹거리며 타이핑을 해서 그 소설 줄거리를 기억하지 못하도록 해 주겠다.

오늘 밤 네 손으로 위대한 소설을 만들어내지 못할 거야, 팔라비 소위. 내가 있는 한 말이야.
